title: Surface Area Revolved About the y-Axis
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the surface area generated by revolving y = x^2 on [0, 1] about the y-axis.

steps.title: Identify Radius and ds for y-Axis Rotation
steps.why: Formulation for rotation about vertical axis.

steps.title: Integrate via u-Substitution
steps.mathExpression: u = 1 + 4x^2 \implies du = 8x \, dx; \quad S = \frac{2\pi}{8} \int_1^5 u^{1/2} du = \frac{\pi}{4} \left[ \frac{2}{3} u^{3/2} \right]_1^5 = \frac{\pi}{6}(5^{3/2} - 1) = \frac{\pi}{6}(5\sqrt{5} - 1)
